blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.text: Mann Care Foundation respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.

blocks.title: Information We Collect
blocks.text: We may collect name, email, phone number, and donation details when you interact with us.

blocks.title: How We Use Information
blocks.text: We use data only for communication, donation processing, and improving services.

blocks.title: Data Protection
blocks.text: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties.

blocks.title: Cookies
blocks.text: Our website may use cookies to improve user experience.
